posts.title: Real talk about the exchange rate
posts.description: (This post reproduces a thread I wrote on Twitter/X on July 29.) A lot of the discussion about the depreciation of/undervaluation of China’s real effective exchange rate takes for granted that this is about the currency. After all, it’s called the “exchange rate”! But it’s actually not. Mostly, it’s about prices. A rant: China’s real […]

posts.title: The best music I heard in 2025
